WRF damp_opt=3 is implicit gravity-wave damping over the top zdamp metres; ERF's analog is Rayleigh damping on w toward wbar with a sine-squared ramp (ERF_MakeMomSources.cpp:485-494, ERF_InitRayleigh.cpp:42-51). zdamp=5000 and dampcoef=0.2 carry over exactly; wbar is zero-filled (ERF_InitRayleigh.cpp:29-30) and no sounding overwrites it on the WRFInput path, so w is damped toward zero as in WRF.
